title.en: AI Consciousness: Intelligence Is Not Experience

excerpt.zh: AI意识仍是开放问题。神经科学家 Anil Seth 提醒，能完成复杂任务并不等于拥有主观体验；把流畅语言误当作意识，可能带来伦理与社会风险。

text.zh: AI意识是否可能存在，仍没有定论。神经科学家 Anil Seth 在《The Mythology of Conscious AI》中提出一个关键区分：人工智能可以表现出解决问题等能力，但这并不能证明系统拥有主观体验，也就是“成为它会是什么样”的感受。
text.en: Whether AI consciousness is possible remains unsettled. In “The Mythology of Conscious AI,” neuroscientist Anil Seth draws a key distinction: an AI system may demonstrate abilities such as problem-solving, but that does not establish subjective experience, or what it is like to be that system.

text.zh: AI意识与智能能力并非一回事
text.en: AI Consciousness Is Not the Same as Intelligent Behavior

text.zh: 文章将智能概括为灵活地运用手段达成复杂目标，而意识关乎体验本身。两者在人类身上并存，不代表在所有系统中必然相连。语言模型能生成流畅回答，因此容易让人联想到理解和感受；但流畅表达本身并不能说明系统具有内在体验。作者也指出，“幻觉”这样的拟人化说法，可能让人不自觉地把人的意识经验投射到机器行为上。
text.en: The essay characterizes intelligence as using flexible means to achieve complex goals, while consciousness concerns experience itself. Their coexistence in humans does not mean they must be linked in every system. Language models produce fluent responses, which can invite assumptions about understanding and feeling; fluency alone, however, does not show that a system has inner experience. Seth also cautions that anthropomorphic terms such as “hallucination” can encourage people to project human experiences onto machine behavior.

text.zh: AI意识判断关系到伦理与公众认知
text.en: Judgments About AI Consciousness Have Ethical Stakes

text.zh: 这场讨论并非纯粹哲学问题。如果未来系统确有意识，痛苦、道德地位乃至权利都可能成为需要面对的问题；若没有充分依据便把系统当作有感受的伙伴，人们也可能受到情感影响，或混淆伦理优先次序。反过来，若公众把可能的意识一概排除，也会错过认真讨论其待遇的时机。
text.en: The debate is not purely philosophical. If future systems were conscious, questions about suffering, moral status and possibly rights would matter. But treating systems as feeling companions without adequate evidence could also shape people’s emotions or distort ethical priorities. Conversely, dismissing the possibility outright could prevent serious consideration of how such systems should be treated.

text.zh: Seth提醒，当前最重要的限制是我们尚无可靠依据，仅凭智能表现或语言能力判断机器是否有意识。AI能力持续进步，确实让问题更迫切，却不能代替意识的证据。如何提出可检验的判断标准，以及怎样在不夸大结论的前提下处理不确定性，仍是开放问题。
text.en: Seth’s central caution is that we currently lack a reliable basis for deciding whether a machine is conscious from intelligent performance or language ability alone. Improving AI capabilities make the question more pressing, but they are not a substitute for evidence of consciousness. Developing testable criteria, and responding to uncertainty without overstating what is known, remain open challenges.
